risks.title: Transaction risk with Banco Santander
risks.score_rationale: Acquisition transaction of $12.3 billion announced on February 3, 2026, subject to regulatory and shareholder approvals, the receipt of which is not guaranteed. Major impact on strategy, operations, and ability to pay dividends or repurchase shares. The Transaction Agreement imposes restrictions on dividends and repurchases until closing.

risks.title: Increase in non-performing assets
risks.score_rationale: Non-performing assets increased from $218.6 million in 2023 to $502.1 million in 2025, more than doubling over two years. The deterioration is documented in the MD&A and represents rising credit risk requiring close monitoring.

risks.title: Economic uncertainty and recession risk
risks.score_rationale: Changes in commercial and economic policies create significant uncertainty that could result in recession. The impact on customer behavior and lending conditions is substantial and extends across all business lines. Cited as a key qualitative adjustment factor in the CECL expected loss allocation model.

risks.title: Net interest margin compression
risks.score_rationale: Net interest margin declined from 3.52% in 2023 to 3.42% in 2025, a contraction of 10 basis points. This declining trend impacts profitability of core banking operations and ability to maintain performance.

risks.title: Increase in operating costs
risks.score_rationale: Efficiency ratio increased from 42.15% in 2023 to 45.99% in 2025, indicating rising operating costs relative to revenues. The two-year upward trend suggests growing pressure on profit margins.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and technology risks
risks.score_rationale: While information security governance is detailed with oversight committees (Information Risk Committee, Risk Committee and Technology Committee of the Board with quarterly reporting), threats to IT systems continually evolve and represent ongoing risk for financial institutions.

ai_positioning.summary: Webster Financial Corporation does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its fiscal year 2025 10-K report.
